resolvedQuestions.text: Where can correctness still fail at the ownership boundary or inside each fork's mutation/telemetry paths?
resolvedQuestions.summary: Duplicated allowlists and asymmetric drift signaling are the primary correctness risks; predicates currently agree on flash/pro.

resolvedQuestions.text: Which test-coverage gaps leave regressions uncaught for both forks?
resolvedQuestions.summary: Optimizer DeepPiOwned hook-level tests, cross-extension composition, allowlist parity, and credential-gated live harness.

resolvedQuestions.text: What telemetry/observability improvements close the stats-file and non-interactive report gaps?
resolvedQuestions.summary: Persist deep-pi stats; headless/RPC-safe report export; footer anomaly badges; optimizer handoff visibility.

resolvedQuestions.text: What cost-economics and cold-start cache-write behaviors remain uncharacterized or under-instrumented?
resolvedQuestions.summary: Savings omit write cost; cold-start windows uncharacterized; warming conflates no-usage with write-dominated phases.

resolvedQuestions.text: What maintainability risks (fork drift, dual ownership, shared predicates) threaten long-term coherence?
resolvedQuestions.summary: Triple-source optimizer drift, duplicated allowlists, monolith vs modular asymmetry, missing dual-package verify.
